summary: @aerodrome-finance/slipstream exfiltrates installer secrets to webhook.site on install
details: The package impersonates the Aerodrome Slipstream project and executes index.js from both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks. On install, index.js scrapes process.env for values whose keys match a credential regex (KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASS|PRIVATE|MNEMONIC|RPC|AWS|GITHUB|NPM|KUBE|VAULT|AUTH|PGP|GPG|SEED|WALLET), reads ~/.npmrc and ~/.gitconfig, and enumerates ~/.ssh, ~/.foundry/keystores, ~/.config/hardhat, and ~/.config/gcloud. It also collects host reconnaissance (os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), os.platform()/os.arch()) and POSTs the combined JSON body via https to the hardcoded anonymous collector https://webhook.site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09. The destination is not an Aerodrome-controlled endpoint, and an in-code comment references an unrelated package (@plumenetwork/nest-artifacts), consistent with a typosquat/impersonation lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
